import sys

oo = 1000000000

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    if n > m:
        n, m = m, n
    size = 1 << n
    curr = [[oo] * size for _ in range(size)]
    for i in range(size):
        curr[0][i] = 0
    for j in range(m):
        next_mat = [[oo] * size for _ in range(size)]
        limit = 1 if j == m - 1 else size
        for c0 in range(size):
            for c1 in range(size):
                curVal = curr[c0][c1]
                if curVal != oo:
                    for c2 in range(limit):
                        done = compute_done(n, c0, c1, c2)
                        newVal = curVal + n - bin(done).count('1')
                        if newVal < next_mat[c1][c2]:
                            next_mat[c1][c2] = newVal
        curr = next_mat
    res = oo
    for row in curr:
        for v in row:
            if v < res:
                res = v
    print(n * m - res)

def compute_done(n, c0, c1, c2):
    done = 0
    for i in range(n):
        if (c1 >> i) & 1 == 0:
            up = i - 1
            down = i + 1
            if up >= 0 and ((c1 >> up) & 1):
                done |= 1 << i
            if down < n and ((c1 >> down) & 1):
                done |= 1 << i
            if (c0 >> i) & 1:
                done |= 1 << i
            if (c2 >> i) & 1:
                done |= 1 << i
    return done

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
